findings: Actual central Schur projectors are Hermitian idempotents, hence PSD. Density trace masses are real and nonnegative. Zero projectors contribute zero, and completeness gives total mass one.
The actual nonzero-projector count is at most (k+1)^(card Ω)^2; averaging gives the reciprocal polynomial bound, with no permutation-invariance hypothesis.
The unit-vector density is the actual partialTraceLeft of vecMulVec v (star v). It is PSD and has trace one. The trace-pairing identity and Qᴴ=Q=Q² give the projected Euclidean norm square exactly.

The bound is positive for all natural k, including k=0, so the projected vector is nonzero. Empty one-copy or auxiliary basis cases require no extra hypothesis; if a unit vector or density cannot exist the original assumptions already exclude it.
No entropy-window, log dλ asymptotic, common Bell sequence, initial uniform-pair occurrence, C-R label matching, or energy conclusion is asserted.
